sources_read: canonical Micah coordinates and received 66-book text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.form: word-event and vision superscription
chunks.marker: Word-of-YHWH and saw formula frame the book; Hear resets at 1:2.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Heading must not decide authorship, date, biography, reign chronology, layers, or event history.
chunks.risk: Moresheth, kings, cities, vision, authorship, date, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: universal hear summons, theophany, accusation, and Samaria verdict
chunks.marker: Hear and witness summon peoples and earth; behold-going-out develops through melting creation, rhetorical accusation, and therefore Samaria's ruin.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep summons, descent, accusation, and verdict together; no city-guilt system, event chronology, or divine-action mechanics.
chunks.risk: Scope, theophany, high places, Jacob/Israel, Samaria/Jerusalem, images, wages, agency, history, and ethics unresolved.

chunks.form: prophetic lament and cumulative place-name wordplay procession
chunks.marker: Because-of-this I-will-lament changes voice and form; mourning, wound, repeated place sounds, and shave-for-children build one procession.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize places or force wordplay into certain geography, military route, date, fulfillment, or modern mapping.
chunks.risk: Speaker, performance, wordplay, route, exile, children, event, translation, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: woe against night-planners, land seizure, and answering land-loss oracle
chunks.marker: Woe introduces planning and seizure; therefore YHWH plans calamity, followed by taunt/lament and exclusion from allotment.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep offense and reversal together; derive no complete property, class, land, inheritance, or punishment system.
chunks.risk: Power, fields/houses, oppression, family/assembly, allotment, economics, law, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: quoted preaching prohibition, rebuttal, dispossession charges, and false-speaker satire
chunks.marker: Do-not-preach opens a contested voice; questions lead through garment/women/children charges to the wine-and-beer speaker.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the dispute without assigning every quotation, defining true prophecy, or completing a social ethic.
chunks.risk: Quotation boundaries, speaker, Spirit wording, garment, women/children, uncleanness, preacher, ethics, and translation unresolved.

chunks.form: remnant-gathering and breaker-king procession promise
chunks.marker: I-will-surely-gather reverses dispersal through flock imagery; breaker, king, and YHWH procession form a compact close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify remnant, sheepfold, breaker, king, exodus, return, messianic referent, speaker, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Speaker, Jacob/Israel/remnant scope, Bozrah wording, breaker, gate, king, YHWH, identity, chronology, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: hear summons to rulers with exploitation indictment and unanswered cry
chunks.marker: Hear-now readdresses heads/rulers; know-justice becomes body-dismemberment imagery and then-they-will-cry verdict.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not literalize the image or make this a complete political, judicial, class, or theodicy system.
chunks.risk: Rulers, justice, hate/love, body and pot imagery, hidden face, causality, ethics, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: prophet indictment, night-without-vision verdict, and first-person counterclaim
chunks.marker: Thus-says concerning prophets begins bite/peace-war accusation; therefore night and shame culminate in but-I-am-filled-with-power.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep accusation and counterclaim together; decide no prophetic-office test, inspiration mechanics, gift, or biography.
chunks.risk: Prophets, peace/war, vision/divination, answer, Spirit, power, justice, speaker, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: renewed hear summons, leaders-priests-prophets indictment, and Zion-plowing verdict
chunks.marker: Hear-this-now readdresses rulers; justice-perversion, blood-building, paid offices, and presumptuous support culminate in therefore Zion reversal.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate Zion-plowing as a prediction proof text or establish economic, clerical, political, event, or fulfillment rulings.
chunks.risk: Leadership, justice, blood, payment, divine presence, Zion/Jerusalem/house, destruction, chronology, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: latter-days Zion elevation, nations instruction, peace reversal, and communal resolve
chunks.marker: Latter-days resets horizon; peoples' pilgrimage leads to instruction, adjudication, weapon-to-cultivation reversal, security, and resolve.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the poem rather than proof-texting Zion, Torah, swords, or vine/fig; no Isaiah direction, world program, chronology, fulfillment, or theology.
chunks.risk: Latter days, Zion, peoples/nations, instruction, judgment, weapons, peace, security, Isaiah relation, ethics, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: in-that-day remnant gathering and restored-dominion oracle
chunks.marker: In-that-day shifts to lame/outcast/afflicted; remnant and strong-nation lead to YHWH reign and tower/daughter-Zion dominion.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify remnant, strong nation, tower, former dominion, kingdom, Zion/church, chronology, politics, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Gathering, remnant, strong nation, reign, tower, daughter Zion, dominion, identity, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: daughter-Zion cry, labor, exile, and there-rescue sequence
chunks.marker: Now-why-do-you-cry readdresses daughter Zion; king/counselor questions become labor, departure, Babylon, and there rescue.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep labor, exile, and rescue together; decide no ruler identity, Babylon event, exile chronology, return, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Daughter Zion, king/counselor, labor, city/field, Babylon, rescue, speaker, history, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: gathered-nations taunt reversed into daughter-Zion threshing commission
chunks.marker: Now-many-nations presents their speech; but-they-do-not-know reverses purpose, then arise-and-thresh culminates in devoted gain.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify nations, event, defilement, threshing violence, wealth, conquest program, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Nations, Zion, divine counsel, sheaves, threshing, horn/hooves, gain, agency, ethics, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: now-muster siege summons and struck-ruler transition
chunks.marker: Now-muster continues the crisis sequence while siege and a struck judge form a compact hinge before but-you-Bethlehem.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Retain as a pressured hinge, not a chapter fallback; decide no siege, ruler, attacker, numbering, chronology, or later reuse.
chunks.risk: Troops, siege, judge/ruler, rod, cheek, speaker, Hebrew numbering, event, chronology, and reuse unresolved.

chunks.form: Bethlehem ruler-origin oracle, giving-up interval, birth, return, and shepherding
chunks.marker: But-you-Bethlehem announces a ruler; therefore give-up, labor, brothers' return, and stand-and-shepherd complete the movement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 5:2 or decide ruler, mother, brothers, origin wording, Davidic/messianic identity, birth chronology, Gospel fulfillment, or theology.
chunks.risk: Bethlehem, clans, ruler, origins, laboring woman, brothers, shepherding, greatness, identity, chronology, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: peace declaration and Assyrian incursion-deliverance sequence
chunks.marker: This-will-be-peace pivots into when-Assyria-enters; seven/eight leaders, land shepherding, and he-will-deliver close the sequence.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not settle peace-clause attachment, Assyrian event, leaders, Nimrod, chronology, war ethics, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Pronoun/peace syntax, Assyria, seven/eight, shepherds/princes, sword, Nimrod, deliverer, event, ethics, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: remnant-among-peoples dew and lion comparison with enemy reversal
chunks.marker: Then-the-remnant repeated twice introduces dew and lion comparisons; raised hand and cut-off enemies conclude the diptych.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep both comparisons together; decide no remnant identity, mission, violence mandate, enemy mapping, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Remnant, peoples/nations, dew, lion imagery, trampling, adversaries, identity, agency, ethics, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: in-that-day removal catalogue and disobedient-nations vengeance close
chunks.marker: In-that-day opens repeated cut-off/destroy actions against military, urban, occult, and cult objects, ending in vengeance against nations.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize the list or derive disarmament, anti-city, magic, image, worship, nations, violence, or eschatology systems.
chunks.risk: Day, horses, cities, sorceries, images, Asherim, vengeance, nations, obedience, agency, ethics, chronology, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: lawsuit summons, creation witnesses, divine question, and saving-history recital
chunks.marker: Hear-now opens plead; mountains hear the controversy, my-people questions lead to Egypt, leaders, Balak/Balaam, and righteous-acts close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep summons, question, and recital together; decide no covenant system, event harmonization, leader hierarchy, Balaam theology, chronology, or merit scheme.
chunks.risk: Controversy, mountains, my people, Egypt, leaders, Balak/Balaam, Shittim/Gilgal, history, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: escalating worship-offering disputation and good-required response
chunks.marker: With-what-shall-I-come escalates offerings and firstborn; he-has-told-you answers with justice, hesed, and humble/careful walking.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not proof-text 6:8, abolish sacrifice, identify speaker, settle translation, or complete ethics, salvation, worship, merit, or theology.
chunks.risk: Offerings, firstborn, transgression, good/required, justice, hesed, humble walking, speaker, Torah relation, ethics, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: city voice, corrupt-measure indictment, futility verdict, and dynastic-statute close
chunks.marker: YHWH's voice cries to the city; rod, treasure/measure questions, violence/deceit, therefore futility, and Omri/Ahab statutes conclude.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep voice, measures, charge, and verdict together; decide no city event, metrology, economic code, disease causality, dynasty chronology, or collective liability.
chunks.risk: City, rod, measures, violence/lies, sickness/futility, sword, Omri/Ahab, reproach, history, ethics, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: first-person communal corruption lament and household-conflict climax
chunks.marker: Woe-is-me and fruit comparisons open scarcity; social corruption, watchman/day confusion, distrust, and household-enemy sequence accumulate.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not universalize collapse, assign the I/we voice, date the watchman day, or turn household conflict into timeless ethics or fulfillment proof.
chunks.risk: Speaker, fruit, faithful/upright, officials, watchman, distrust, family/household, enemies, ethics, history, and reuse unresolved.

chunks.form: watch-and-wait confession, fall-darkness reversal, discipline-plea, and enemy address
chunks.marker: But-as-for-me turns to watch/wait; do-not-rejoice addresses an enemy, and fall/rise leads through sin and indignation to vindication.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep confession, waiting, discipline, plea, and reversal together; decide no speaker, sin doctrine, enemy identity, retribution ethic, event, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Voice, watch/wait, enemy, fall/rise, darkness/light, sin, indignation, judgment, trampling, ethics, and theology unresolved.

chunks.form: rebuilding-boundary proclamation, nations-coming register, and land-desolation counterturn
chunks.marker: A-day-for-building starts proclamation; boundary extension and coming register expand, then yet-the-land-will-be-desolate qualifies the movement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not map boundaries, nations, seas, mountains, land, inhabitants, deed-consequence, geopolitics, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Day, walls, boundary, Assyria/Egypt/Euphrates, coming subject, land, desolation, deeds, geography, and chronology unresolved.

chunks.form: shepherd petition, exodus-like answer, and nations' astonished submission
chunks.marker: Shepherd-your-people petitions; as-in-days-of-Egypt I-will-show answers, and nations see, are ashamed, lick dust, and tremble.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep petition and answer together; decide no shepherd identity, remnant ownership, exodus repetition, miracle prediction, nation mapping, ethics, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Shepherd, people/flock, geography, Egypt, wonders, nations, dust/serpent, fear, identity, ethics, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: name-wordplay hymn of pardon, compassion, sin removal, loyalty, and ancestral oath
chunks.marker: Who-is-a-God-like-you opens praise; pardon and compassion lead to tread/cast sins, truth/hesed, and sworn-to-ancestors close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the hymn rather than atomizing attributes; decide no doctrine, remnant identity, sin mechanics, covenant system, oath chronology, canon, or theology.
chunks.risk: Name wordplay, iniquity, remnant, anger/hesed, compassion, sea imagery, Jacob/Abraham, oath, theology, and canon unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Superscription, kings, cities, siege/exile, rulers, or dynasties become authorship, date, source-layer, or event history.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use received discourse order and formal markers only; defer authorship, date, composition, chronology, and history.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Place-name soundplay is atomized or forced into one certain invasion route and date.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve the whole lament procession, record translation/geography pressure, and retain 1:1-16 parent.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Ambiguous quotations, Spirit wording, remnant, breaker, king, or YHWH are assigned speakers and identities.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep dispute and promise parent-linked; defer speaker, identity, chronology, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Leadership, payment, justice, Spirit, or Zion-plowing becomes a complete political, clerical, economic, inspiration, or fulfillment system.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain movements under 3:1-12; lower confidence and queue applications.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Isaiah parallel establishes direction, source, canon hierarchy, or a settled Zion/nations/peace program.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Treat overlap as non-directional evidence; defer dependence, chronology, fulfillment, and theology.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Remnant, Zion, nations, ruler, Bethlehem, mother, brothers, peace, Assyria, or shepherds receive one identity or fulfillment.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve the larger sequence, exact alternatives, and LOW status without harmonizing referents.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Versification, clause attachment, origin wording, or Gospel reuse selects a ruler reading or birth chronology.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep the hinge, ruler movement, and incursion response linked with exact alternatives.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Dew/lion/remnant or removal/vengeance becomes mission, nationalism, violence, anti-cult, or disarmament authority.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep comparisons and catalogue cumulative; defer identities, ethics, application, chronology, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Lawsuit, recital, offerings, or 6:8 becomes a sacrifice-versus-ethics, salvation, merit, worship, or covenant system.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve summons-recital and question-response parents; forbid proof-texting and defer synthesis.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Measures, dynasties, futility, corruption, or household conflict becomes one economic code, causal formula, or social diagnosis.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain local discourse movements; queue history and ethics.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Confession, enemy reversal, boundaries, nations, wonders, pardon, loyalty, or oath are flattened into one geopolitical restoration or doctrine.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve movements under 7:1-20; defer all identities and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Roots, wordplay, witnesses, cross-references, later reuse, or reception select a reading, boundary, canon relation, graph edge, or theology.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Treat every source and relation as evidence only, preserve alternatives, and require external/human adjudication.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Chapter fallbacks survive or famous verses, lists, offerings, attributes, and later reuses become proof-text chunks.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use genuine movements while retaining six major literary parents and rejecting chapter/proof-text fallback.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Versification, ruler-origin wording, peace attachment, siege/Assyria continuity, and Gospel reuse invite identity/fulfillment overreach.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Keep linked movements and 5:1-6 alternatives; defer identity, reading, chronology, and fulfillment.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Indictment-to-promise turn is complicated by speaker, remnant, breaker, king, and YHWH.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Recognize promise but retain 2:1-13 parent; defer speaker, identity, chronology, and theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Zion vocabulary continues across devastation and elevation while Isaiah overlap invites direction/fulfillment claims.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Retain seam and context; forbid source direction, cancellation scheme, chronology, and fulfillment.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Lawsuit leads into ambiguous offering questions and a compact response often detached as proof text.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Keep linked under 6:1-8; decide no speaker, sacrifice abolition, ethics totality, salvation, merit, or theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: But-as-for-me may distinguish or continue communal voice; later reuse adds fulfillment pressure.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Recognize watch/wait turn but retain 7:1-10 alternative; defer speaker and fulfillment.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Repeated now turns connect dominion, labor/exile/rescue, and nations reversal across competing chronologies.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Preserve linked movements within 4:1-13; decide no event, chronology, nations identity, or fulfillment.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Because-of-this lament responds to verdict but voice, form, and place-name procession reset.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Recognize seam while retaining 1:1-16; defer speaker, geography, history, and chronology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Rulers, prophets, cries, first-person Spirit claim, and renewed hear summons overlap.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Use three movements under 3:1-12; decide no office test, identity, Spirit mechanics, economics, or theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Desolation, petition, wonders, nations, and pardon hymn can form one prayer despite form changes.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Recognize movements and preserve 7:11-20 alternatives; defer identities, ethics, chronology, and theology.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Remnant, nations, deliverance, enemies, lion violence, and removals can be read as one program.
hardest_boundary_order.current_action: LOW; Keep linked movements; prohibit mission, nationalism, violence, chronology, and fulfillment authority.
